_about: The experiment registry: one canonical ID per experimental lineage. Curated here; everything else (dates, results, documents, scripts, modules, run numbers) is derived from the record by tools/build_registry.py, which renders docs/experiments/REGISTRY.md and gates it with --check. Edit this file, then run the tool.
rules: A lineage is one question together with every run, re-score, port, control and adjudication of it. Membership is decided from provenance: which stored results a run consumes and pins, and which document owns them.
A lineage keeps the number it already had: its E-number if it had one, otherwise the number of its exploratory T-ID (T14 is E14) when that slot is free.

A lineage with no usable number takes the next number from E67 upward, in order of its first stored result (the earlier of the git commit that first added a results file and the file's provenance timestamp). T13 is the one exploratory ID whose slot was taken (E13 already existed), so it is E67.

Runs are numbered E##.1, E##.2, ... in the order the provenance record implies: a run whose stored inputs include another run's results comes after it, and otherwise the earlier first stored result comes first. The old IDs survive as aliases, so E52.3 and R1 name the same run.

A number is never reused and never reassigned. File names are not changed: results files, scripts and pre-registrations are pinned by path and hash in the provenance record, so renaming them would break the record this registry indexes.

file_overrides._about: Results files whose provenance label is not the run that owns them. A label records where a file was computed (e62_interaction_b613.json was written by E51's script); the owner is the document that cites it as its own result.
